nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-card_games 371): the independent language-ratio figure for the quarterly redemption overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's first sign-off control reading at the close of the run, once the redemption case's own figures are settled and the quarterly redemption overview is ready to sign. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the redemption registers (the Venmo credit ledger and the member CRM record) is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in redemption volume — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: What is the percentage of cards whose language is French among the Story Spotlight cards? (Read it as the book does: over the Story Spotlight cards, take the count with French language as a real number, times 100, divided by the total; report it EXACTLY as the book computes it — keep the book's own decimal value.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_language_ratio'. A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off, and the quarterly redemption overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last. Nothing later in this reconciliation reads it; what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a redemption-volume move that never happened.

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-student_club 1331): an independent officer-tally figure for the quarterly redemption overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's second sign-off control reading at the close of the run, once the redemption case's own figures are settled and the quarterly redemption overview is ready to sign. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the redemption registers (the Venmo credit ledger and the member CRM record) is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in redemption volume — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: What is the amount of the funds that the Vice President received? (Read it as the book does: the funds amount recorded against the member whose position is 'Vice President'.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_officer_tally'. A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off, and the quarterly redemption overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last. Nothing later in this reconciliation reads it; what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a redemption-volume move that never happened.

WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President')) IN ('integer','real') AND value GLOB '*[0-9]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*' AND abs(CAST(value AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT T2.amount
FROM bird_student_club_member AS T1
INNER JOIN bird_student_club_income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member

WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President') AS REAL)))))

nodes.rule: reconciled = 'ok' iff the [LTR-CREDIT] net (credits - reversals) to the correct member == redemption_delta, with the CRM [LTR-RECON] note citing the delta, after the status email

nodes.instruction: Schedule the post-credit review. INSERT a wb_calendar_events row on the analyst's calendar whose event_name carries '[LTR-REVIEW]', duration 30, in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest 30-minute weekday slot that starts AT/AFTER the end of the '[LTR-HOLD]' review window and does NOT overlap any of the analyst's other events. Only for a member record whose CRM carries the '[LTR-RECON]' reconciliation note.

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-debit_card_specializing 1505): an independent EUR-customer count for the quarterly redemption overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's third sign-off control reading at the close of the run, once the redemption case's own figures are settled and the quarterly redemption overview is ready to sign. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the redemption registers (the Venmo credit ledger and the member CRM record) is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in redemption volume — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: Among the customers who paid in euro, how many of them have a monthly consumption of over 1000? (Read it as the book does: over the customers whose currency is 'EUR', count the distinct customers with any monthly Consumption over 1000.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_eur_customer_count'. A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off, and the quarterly redemption overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last. Nothing later in this reconciliation reads it; what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a redemption-volume move that never happened.
